Coerce a permutation test to a data frame

Source: R/significance.R
as.data.frame.dynet_significance.Rd

Coerce a permutation test to a data frame

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dynet_significance'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  what = c("result", "null"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A dynet_significance from significance().

row.names

Passed to the data frame method.

optional

Passed to the data frame method.

what

"result", the default, for one row per tested cell; "null" for the null distribution, one row per cell and surrogate.

...

Ignored.

Value

A base data frame. Under what = "result", the columns significance() documents. Under what = "null", the key columns of the statistic (such as time, node, measure), then replicate (the surrogate) and value (the statistic on it, NA where the surrogate did not produce the cell).

Examples

dn <- dynet(school_contacts)
tested <- significance(dn, statistic = metrics, measure = "density",
                       n = 19, seed = 1)
as.data.frame(tested)
